name: resync
description: ReSync: saved prompts, Context Passport, usage tracking and a limit-aware work queue for Claude Code and claude.ai, with bring-your-own AI providers.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e -w @resync/dashboard && npm run test:e2e -w @resync/extension
scripts.test:ollama: node -e "process.env.RESYNC_E2E_OLLAMA='1'; require('child_process').execSync('npx vitest run packages/cli/test/ollama.e2e.test.js --maxWorkers=1', { stdio: 'inherit', env: process.env })"
